text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Kabariti gets phone call from U.S. Secretary of State Christopher, both discuss developments in the Palestinian-Israeli negotiations and means of ensuring the success of the coming Cairo economic summit.
- Consular services to begin between the Red Sea resort towns of Aqaba and Eilat for tourists between Jordan and Israel.
- King Hussein-Egyptian President Mubarak summit a key step towards removing obstacles on the way to peace.
- Jordanian economic delegation to open the Jordan industrial products fair in the West Bank town of Ramallah this month.
- Crown Prince Hassan arrives in Sarajevo at the start of a visit to Croatia and Bosnia.

- Kabariti calls for easing procedures and eliminating red tape during visit to Amman Customs Bureau and the Amman Financial Market (AMF); head of stock market says there is increased foreign investment in the bourse.
